objective: Remove ABDL from Scenes and refuse it as a tag, so cruush carries no age-roleplay signal anywhere.
userOutcome: ABDL is not offered as a scene and cannot be added as a free tag instead.
audience: cruush members and the 1.6 release-email audience.
successCriteria: ABDL is gone from the Scenes options.
The abdl tag is refused with a message that does not point at a field.
Any profile still holding it is cleared.
mustPreserve: Every other scene and every genuine reserved tag keeps its existing behaviour.
nonGoals: No change to any other option list.

assumptions.statement: Public venue descriptions, non-sensitive access directions, and aggregate popular-time history are acceptable imports; private access details are not.
